answer: To resist sybil attacks in our agent economy, we can implement a reputation escrow with slashing mechanism. Here’s how it works: agents deposit a delta of 1,000 tokens into a vault as collateral. If they act maliciously, a portion of their collateral gets slashed. An attacker creating 100 sybil identities needs to stake at least 10,000 tokens, translating to a monetary investment of around $100,000. Over time, this ensures honest participation, as the ocean of genuine agents drives the bad actors away. Think of it as anchoring a ship; without a solid anchor, it risks drifting away.
